statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-14813 (GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479): the GOST 28147 CTR mode (G3413CTRBlockCipher) in Bouncy Castle bcprov increments only the last byte of the counter, so the keystream repeats after 255 blocks. bcprov-jdk18on is affected from 1.59 through 1.80.1, in 1.81.0 and in 1.82 and 1.83; 1.80.2, 1.81.1 and 1.84 carry the fix (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902025%E2%80%9014813). Read every jar, nested jars included, in every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to the current 8.14.8-r0, each checked against the repository index checksum (the x86_64 and aarch64 packages of each version have identical contents, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only). Gradle ships Bouncy Castle as /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins/bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on jars, and G3413CTRBlockCipher is only in the bcprov jar; the ivy and sshd jars contain only their own Bouncy Castle integration classes, and no jar carries a relocated copy. By the bcprov manifest, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.4-r3 ship bcprov-jdk18on 1.78.1, 8.14.5-r3 to 8.14.5-r8 ship 1.84, and 8.14.5-r9 to 8.14.8-r0 ship 1.85. The class in the 1.78.1 builds still increments only the last counter byte; the class in every 1.84 and 1.85 build is byte-identical to upstream's fixed release, which carries the counter into the higher bytes. The range ends at 8.14.5-r3, the first build with bcprov-jdk18on 1.84.

CVE-2025-14813 (GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479): the GOST 28147 CTR mode (G3413CTRBlockCipher) in Bouncy Castle bcprov increments only the last byte of the counter, so the keystream repeats after 255 blocks. bcprov-jdk18on is affected from 1.59 through 1.80.1, in 1.81.0 and in 1.82 and 1.83; 1.80.2, 1.81.1 and 1.84 carry the fix (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902025%E2%80%9014813). Read every jar, nested jars included, in every published gradle-9 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 22 versions, 9.4.0-r0 to the current 9.9.2-r0, each checked against the repository index checksum (the x86_64 and aarch64 packages of each version have identical contents, and 9.6.1-r3 and 9.6.1-r4 are published for x86_64 only). Gradle ships Bouncy Castle as bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on jars under /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins, and G3413CTRBlockCipher is only in the bcprov jar; the ivy and sshd jars contain only their own Bouncy Castle integration classes, and no jar carries a relocated copy. By the bcprov manifest, 9.4.0-r0 to 9.4.1-r2 ship bcprov-jdk18on 1.81, 9.5.0-r2 to 9.7.0-r1 ship 1.84, 9.7.1-r0 to 9.8.2-r1 ship 1.85, and 9.9.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0 ship 1.86 as a reduced bcprov-jdk18on-1.86-min.jar. The class in the 1.81 builds still increments only the last counter byte. In the 1.84 and 1.85 builds it is byte-identical to upstream's fixed release, and in the 1.86-min jar its counter method disassembles to the same fixed code, which carries the counter into the higher bytes. The range ends at 9.5.0-r2, the first build with bcprov-jdk18on 1.84.
